exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Must/Have to".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
～なきゃいけない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～なきゃいけない matches "Must/Have to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～なきゃいけない.
exercises.explanation: Used to express that something must or has to be done; obligation.

exercises.question: Choose the correct meaning for: ～なきゃいけない.

options.text: Must/Have to
Such as A and B
Not as much/less than
Not as...as

exercises.correctFeedback: Correct! ～なきゃいけない means "Must/Have to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct meaning is "Must/Have to".
exercises.explanation: Used to express that something must or has to be done; obligation.
